stem.text: A student uses a cathode-ray oscilloscope (c.r.o.) to measure the period of a signal. She sets the time-base of the c.r.o. to $5\,\text{ms cm}^{-1}$ and observes the trace illustrated below. The trace has a length of $10.0\,\text{cm}$.

stem.alt: Trace on a c.r.o. screen with dashed vertical lines at each end and a horizontal double arrow labelled 10.0 cm spanning the trace.

stem.text: What is the period of the signal?
